$comment: Services whose architecture file is not written yet. An entry is a dated
gap, never a permission: the day the file exists the entry must go, or
C18 reports it as stale. Subjects are estate.json; this file only says
which of them are still pending and since when.
Empty today: every registry entry already has a services/<name>.md file
in TAIPANBOX/architecture as of 2026-09-09, so there is nothing to record
as pending. Add an entry here only for a repository whose file has not
been written, with the date and a reason; do not add one to excuse a file

keyryx.why: A GAP, not a decision. keyryx was registered in estate.json on 2026-10-18 and its services/keyryx.md dossier is not written yet. The dossier lives in TAIPANBOX/architecture, which this change does not touch; writing it is that repository's next change. Remove this entry the day the file exists.
